title: Tim Norden

body:
# Tim Norden

# President

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/nordin-profile.jpg)

- Signed off on the **[radical equity policy](https://resources.finalsite.net/images/v1718729678/ecasdus/hs8jd6u1d60a5ldew8eb/School-Board-Equity-Statement-Final-signed.pdf)** that pushes the narrative of white privilege, systemic racism, and the hiring of employees based on race.
- **[Supports](https://www.christianpost.com/news/scotus-wont-stop-schools-hiding-gender-transition-from-parents.html)** keeping gender identity secrets from parents: “And for some students, in some situations, we have to understand the context of that and know that if they’re not safe and they trust an adult at the school, that might be the only adult that they have to trust in their lives,” said Nordin. “And that’s important to keeping children safe.”
